card.name: Linking words before a named drug
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation (with, of, a comma, an opening bracket) and 'inhibitors' that come right before a specific drug name in drug-interaction or overdose text. It also fires on a few similar spots in news text.

modes.label: Link before drug name
modes.description: A preposition or comma that sits right before the name of a particular drug.
modes.example: There is no specific antidote for overdose<< with>> VIRACEPT.

modes.label: Drug class word before examples
modes.description: The word 'inhibitors' after 'protease', right before specific drug names are listed.

card.writes: It seems to raise the odds of a proper name coming next (like Obama or Hamas) and lower older historical names, which is not a clear drug-related effect.
card.plain: It marks the small word just before a specific drug name is about to appear.
